contexts.applicability_summary: Voters casting a regular in-person ballot on Election Day.
qualifiers: Use the authoritative state/local instructions for any expiration, name-match, or address-match rules.
contexts.fallback_if_missing_id: Ask poll workers or the listed help path for the official fallback process and whether an alternate or provisional process is available under state law.

contexts.applicability_summary: First-time voters in the state who registered by mail and have not already satisfied the applicable federal-law identification requirement.
qualifiers: Federal-law baseline may apply in this context; state law may impose additional requirements or accepted alternatives.
contexts.fallback_if_missing_id: Follow the official help path before the return deadline to determine accepted alternatives or another official voting path.

freshness_note: ID-requirements content refreshes within 15 minutes of an approved public change notice during active voting periods.
